Simple examples to get started with PraisonAIUI.

The apps live in examples/python/. Each one adds one concept; run it from its folder. @aiui.profiles switching aiui run app.py 06-dashboard Custom pages with @aiui.page aiui run app.py --style dashboard 07-provider-praisonai A custom BaseProvider and the RunEvent protocol aiui run
